identity_and_storage.grain: One daily aggregate per original source generation; different generations on the same calendar date remain distinct rows
identity_and_storage.date: LocalDate carried by exact UTC-midnight TIMESTAMP; null, nonmidnight or fractional carriers fail without truncation/timezone shifting
identity_and_storage.business_version: Required full lowercase 64-character SHA-256, [0-9a-f]{64}; not an abbreviated version or a physical snapshot token
identity_and_storage.generation_algorithm: Original _versions hashes product SQL identity and each day's selected source table id/partition payload. The source global WAL frontier settles and invalidates the partition-state cache; it is not substituted for the original per-day hash
identity_and_storage.physical_read_version: Shared reader freezes tables id/directoryName/table_txn plus settled WAL sequencerTxn/writerTxn/buffered/suspended state before/after SELECT. Cursor sourceVersion is the physical table token; row.sourceVersion remains the business SHA
identity_and_storage.cursor: Real reader-returned queryFingerprint plus complete date/SHA key position and physical sourceVersion; changed query, malformed SHA, unsettled WAL or changed physical version must fail before a success page

outputs_in_card_order.unit: yi yuan; source yuan converted once in aggregate SQL
exact rowwise fake-support plus fake-pressure count

null_precision_and_semantics.counts_differ_from_native_parent: D098/D099 SQL SUM outputs preserve nullable Long. The actual Python cache model instead requires all four int fields, and prepare_questdb_dataframe model_validate rejects NULL before write. D100 therefore uses required long. Historical invalid NULL is explicitly rejected; it is never filled with zero
null_precision_and_semantics.counts: Required nonnegative exact Long values, including zero and Long.MAX_VALUE. Negative/wrapped values, wrong numeric carriers and values outside Long representation fail; no Double/float count transport
null_precision_and_semantics.doubles: Eight nullable finite Double values preserve null, signed zero and stored bits; no extra amount conversion or unproved ratio/entropy/MFI clamp
null_precision_and_semantics.manipulation: Original SQL sums the rowwise fake_support_count + fake_pressure_count expression. Either-null operand makes that row expression null before SUM; no COALESCE and no split SUM. A final NULL aggregate is not publishable by the required-count cache model
null_precision_and_semantics.digest: Original thirteen-field record/frame digest uses YYYYMMDD dates, <NA> null marker and .17g floating serialization. Java does not invent or replace coverage receipts/digests

python_references.fact: Actual fourteen-column MONTH/versioned-DEDUP model and required counts versus nullable doubles
Each record is validated against the model before schema ordering/coercion; LONG uses Int64
Thirteen aggregate expressions, l2_daily_features.ts calendar-day grain and one source-yuan conversion
Actual sole publisher, source/WAL state, per-day SHA, complete-key value/digest visibility verification before coverage publication
Active native alias range/latest path bypasses Python cache; nonnative cache path is retained
Retail sentiment application caller selects v_retail_sentiment_daily
Actual nullable source fields and LONG/DOUBLE storage declarations
Amount is normalized Price times Volume or supplied Turnover; signed directed amount retains direction
Retail time entropy uses Shannon base 2 and amount from retail windows
Q1/Q3 are counts of inflow+rise and outflow+decline windows

Retail ratio is GMM-classified retail volume divided by total volume
Source implementation retains score above zero without an enforced upper-one clamp
